name: First Nations
description: Weaving, star quilts and formline, with the marks that go with them.
long_description: For Native and First Nations communities and the people who stand with them. Three banners — stepped weaving, an eight-pointed star quilt, and an orca built from crescents and trigons — the four directions round the picture, and trophies for the red handprint, an eagle feather and the medicine wheel. The artwork is original work in these design traditions, not a copy of any nation's, family's or weaver's own design.
